title: Precision in Pixels: Master CSS 'font-kerning' for Optimal Web Typography
tweet: Boost your UI's visual harmony! Learn how CSS 'font-kerning' refines spacing between specific letter pairs for superior web typography and user experience. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts
tip: Enhance the professional appearance and readability of your text by intelligently adjusting the spacing between problematic letter combinations (like 'Va', 'We', 'To'). CSS 'font-kerning' allows the browser to utilize kerning tables embedded in your web fonts, significantly improving the visual balance and user experience, especially for headings and larger display text.
